tool: https://udirobert.github.io/seer-six/tools/a11y.mjs — the harness that produced this JSON, published beside it

reduceSnaps.claim: with motion reduced, no arrival animates for longer than one frame — every transition resolves to its end state instead of pausing halfway

motionRuns.claim: with motion on, the same arrivals are visibly running for the leg’s whole interval

intervalHonesty.claim: the motion measured on arrival lands on the five-step scale the contract declares, per leg

objectSurvives.claim: Chromium runs a group animation for a view-transition-name found on both sides of the boundary and for no other, so a paired name is the browser’s record that the object crossed

coldCuts.claim: a cold arrival has no previous document, so the boundary morph never runs, yet the page renders complete

structureSurvives.claim: every static cue the motion stands for is on screen at three widths, both motion states

depthLabels.claim: each document states its surface number and depth from the protocol root in words
